en:
I was thinking... Would you be interested 
in trying cosplay, Shuichi?
Huh?

You seem to enjoy hearing about cosplay, 
so I figured you might want to try it.
W-Well, I *am* interested...
Umm...

You could probably pull anything off. 
You might even be great at crossplay...
<CLT=cltMIND>
<CLT=cltMIND>She's already sizing me up!?

Hey, if you were to cosplay, what 
would you want to be?
Ah, I-I haven't agreed to anything yet...
A realistic school uniform?
A medieval knight?
A girl?
Are you unsure of something?

What sort of character can you 
see yourself cosplaying as?
Maybe...a realistic school uniform?

Well, a lot of people think that'd 
be easy to start with...

But don't fall into that trap! Uniforms 
seem easy, but they're actually hard.

You can't make any alterations and you 
have to be really creative with materials.
Maybe...a medieval knight?

A knight...so you could protect a princess, 
right? I see...so that's what you're into.
D-Don't laugh...

Oh, no. Don't misunderstand.
I'm not making fun of you.

I also started cosplaying because I 
looked up to cute princesses.

I'm kinda...happy that you're 
the same, Shuichi.
Maybe...a girl?

Right off the bat!? 
Wow, you've got guts, Shuichi!

But I understand wanting to be 
a different you when dressing up.

So...that means you do want to 
try cosplay, right? Right!?

W-Wait a minute!
I'm still not sure...

You could make a pretty good Shizuo. 
Well, except your voice anyway.

Your eyes are a good match for Genos...
Oh! Or Mikazuki might be good, too!
<CLT=cltMIND>She really is sizing me up!

But I think for you...Kanata the White
would probably be the best.

Kanata the White? From that show
they used to play in the mornings?
What!? You know about it, Shuichi?
Yeah, I really liked it.

Whaaaaat!? Seriously!? 
What a super coincidence!
<CLT=cltMIND>A coincidence?

Hey, Shuichi! I'll make you a Kanata 
outfit, so let's cosplay!
And let's go to a con together!
R-Really!?

The truth is, that first outfit I made 
was a cosplay of Kanata.

Hm? So that cosplayer that wanted 
to wear it was a boy?

No, she's a girl who's good at 
crossplaying as male characters.

But that aside, I didn't think our 
tastes would be this similar!
Whoa!

<CLT=cltMIND>Before I could react, Tsumugi grabbed my
hand and swung it back and forth.

To think I'd meet someone I could 
talk with here! I'm really happy!

This outfit will be a return to my roots, 
so I'm super excited to make it!
Y-Yeah...
Ah!

<CLT=cltMIND>When she realized we were holding
hands, she blushed and went still.
<CLT=cltMIND>...But she didn't let go.

Sorry...I got too excited since I found 
someone like me...

Um...I'm just a cosplay fangirl, 
but I'll do my best for you, Shuichi...

So won't you join me? I want to teach 
you about the world of cosplay, Shuichi.
<CLT=cltMIND>The sparkle in her eyes was back.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi is inviting me into the world
of cosplay, the world she loves so dearly.
<CLT=cltMIND>So I simply nodded.
Okay, Tsumugi.

Yay! Then once we get out of here, let's 
go to a con together! It's a promise!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi resumed swinging my hand
back and forth, giggling.

<CLT=cltMIND>A promise... A promise that
we'd make it out of here.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I will keep that promise.
We have that bond now.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...cosplay, huh?
I suppose it doesn't hurt to try.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tsumugi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>2D Love<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi spent the next few hours
fangirling about cosplay with me.
